newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Same Time jumps after share placement.
newsitem.headline: Same Time jumps after share placement.

text.p: Shares of Same Time Holdings Ltd surged on expectation of room on the upside after the company announced a share placement, brokers said.
"Speculation that market makers may try to boost the price before they sell fueled short-term demand," said a sales manager at regional brokerage.
The shares were up HK$0.37 or 44.05 percent to HK$1.21 in late morning after they hit an all time high of HK$1.24. Volume was 84.31 million shares worth HK$86.16 million.

The electronic group said on Friday it would place 26 million new shares to major shareholder Sum Tai Holdings Ltd after Sum Tai agreed to place the same amount of existing shares at HK$0.76 each to private and institutional investors.
It said net proceeds would be used for working capital.
